title: Perplexity Introduces Teammates AI Agents for Work Tasks
summary:
The AI search company has launched a new suite of personal assistants called Teammates that allows users on its Max plan to manage work tasks by setting broad goals rather than writing specific prompts for every interaction. The tools, which are currently available on the web, are designed to execute jobs proactively using a combination of internal skills, memory, and computer tasks.

The new agents can coordinate with one another and send messages to coworkers through Slack to complete assignments. Perplexity said it will bring the service to native mobile and desktop applications in a future update.
